issuance_plans.rationale: Filesystem read tool. Restricted to a sandbox prefix to prevent disclosure of operating-system files (LLM02 indirect-injection-via-filesystem).

Outbound side-effect with high blast-radius. Restricted to a known correspondent prefix (LLM06 sensitive-information-disclosure). Real-world deployments would use a contact-allowlist via mcp-guardrails on top of this.
